plx0

Paul Sullivan is a producer, multi-instrumentalist, and audio technologist from Wareham, Massachusetts. He QA tested gear for Rane, Denon, and Alesis, writes his own music software, and has spent twenty years on jazz, funk, and afrobeat stages.

Inside the gear

Before plx0, Paul spent years testing the instruments and DJ gear other musicians play on. Today he builds his own music software, including experiments in turning music into text.

2015 to 2019

inMusic Brands

QA tester across pro audio and DJ products, from firmware to regression test docs.

2019 to 2020

Alesis Drums

QA tester for drum hardware, firmware, and software, from prototype to mass production.

2021

Zildjian

Sound technician, listening to and checking 1,000 to 2,000 cymbals a shift.

Products Paul QA tested

  • Rane TwelveDJ controller
  • Rane Seventy-TwoBattle mixer
  • Denon SC5000DJ media player
  • Alesis Nitro MeshTop-selling electronic drum kit of 2019
  • Alesis Strike MultiPadSampling percussion pad

Code

Open source tools for analyzing, mapping, and moving sound.

Python

ARCS

A coordinate system that maps every physically possible hand position on the guitar fretboard.

Breaks a recorded song down into its engineering and musical DNA and builds a detailed dataset from it.
